symptom: PC in VLAN 10 can reach its gateway but not a file server also in VLAN 10 on the same switch
topology_note: SW1 access switch, VLAN10 for Accounting, PC1 on Fa0/2, Server1 on Fa0/8
show_output: show mac address-table: no entry learned for Server1's MAC on Fa0/8
expected_fault: MAC address not learned - port possibly down or cable fault

symptom: Newly added PC on VLAN 20 cannot reach anything, not even its own gateway
topology_note: SW1 access switch, VLAN20 configured but not yet created on switch
show_output: show vlan brief: VLAN 20 missing from output entirely
expected_fault: VLAN not created on switch (no vlan 20 in database)

symptom: Two switches lose all inter-VLAN connectivity after a trunk port reconfiguration
topology_note: SW1-SW2 trunk link Gi0/1
show_output: show interfaces gi0/1 switchport: Administrative Mode: static access
expected_fault: Trunk port accidentally reconfigured as access port

symptom: Remote branch cannot ping HQ loopback despite interfaces showing up/up
topology_note: R1-R2 over GRE tunnel, tunnel source/destination configured
show_output: show interface tunnel0: tunnel protection state Down, keepalive failures
expected_fault: GRE tunnel keepalive failures / tunnel line protocol down

symptom: PC obtains an IP but gateway ping has intermittent high latency and drops
topology_note: VLAN30 client, switch port has duplex mismatch with upstream router
show_output: show interfaces fa0/5: half-duplex, late collisions incrementing
expected_fault: Duplex mismatch between switch port and router interface

symptom: Site-to-site VPN tunnel fails to establish between two routers
topology_note: R1-R2 IPSec tunnel over ISP link
show_output: show crypto isakmp sa: no active SA, phase 1 negotiation failing
expected_fault: ISAKMP/IKE phase 1 mismatch (pre-shared key or policy mismatch)

symptom: Users behind R1 report slow web browsing while file transfers are fine
topology_note: R1 has QoS policy applied to Gi0/0
show_output: show policy-map interface gi0/0: class WEB-TRAFFIC matches 0 packets
expected_fault: QoS class-map ACL not matching intended web traffic

symptom: Static route to remote office disappears from routing table intermittently
topology_note: R1 has a floating static route as backup to EIGRP
show_output: show ip route: static route missing, administrative distance misconfigured lower than EIGRP
expected_fault: Floating static route AD set too low, overriding dynamic route unexpectedly

symptom: PC cannot join the domain; authentication requests time out
topology_note: VLAN10 client, DHCP-assigned DNS points to old decommissioned server
show_output: show run | include dns-server: dns-server 192.168.1.99 (server decommissioned)
expected_fault: DHCP-supplied DNS server address is stale/decommissioned

symptom: Voice VLAN phones fail to receive correct QoS trust settings
topology_note: SW1 access port configured for data + voice VLAN
show_output: show interfaces fa0/10 switchport: Voice VLAN: none
expected_fault: Voice VLAN not configured on access port

symptom: After a switch reload, all previously configured VLANs are gone
topology_note: SW1 standalone switch, config not saved before reload
show_output: show vlan brief: only default VLANs 1,1002-1005 present
expected_fault: Running-config not saved to startup-config before reload

symptom: Router randomly reboots and loses all interface configuration
topology_note: R1 branch router, no RAM/flash faults reported
show_output: show version: uptime resets correlate with power supply faults in log
expected_fault: Hardware power instability causing unexpected reloads

symptom: PC can ping across VLANs but web management page on switch is unreachable
topology_note: SW1 management VLAN 99 configured with IP but no default gateway
show_output: show running-config | include ip default-gateway: (no output)
expected_fault: Missing management default gateway on switch SVI

symptom: EtherChannel between two switches shows only one link active instead of two
topology_note: SW1-SW2 Port-channel1 (Gi0/1, Gi0/2)
show_output: show etherchannel summary: Gi0/2 individual, not bundled - mismatched channel-group mode
expected_fault: EtherChannel mode mismatch (active/passive vs on) preventing bundle

symptom: Wireless clients on 5GHz band cannot connect while 2.4GHz works fine
topology_note: AP broadcasting dual-band SSID CORP-WIFI
show_output: show wlan summary: 5GHz radio admin state: disabled
expected_fault: 5GHz radio administratively disabled on access point

symptom: Remote users over VPN can reach internal servers but not the internet
topology_note: R1 split-tunnel VPN policy applied
show_output: show run | section crypto map: no split-tunnel ACL matching internet-bound traffic
expected_fault: Split-tunnel ACL misconfigured, routing all traffic through tunnel

symptom: Switch stack member is not forwarding traffic despite green status LED
topology_note: SW1 stack of 3 switches, member 2 recently added
show_output: show switch: member 2 in Version-Mismatch state
expected_fault: Switch stack software version mismatch on new member

symptom: OSPF routes from a newly added router are not appearing in the routing table
topology_note: R3 added to existing OSPF area 0 topology
show_output: show ip ospf database: R3 not listed in LSDB
expected_fault: OSPF process not enabled on the correct interface (missing network statement)

symptom: PC assigned static IP cannot reach anything outside its own subnet
topology_note: PC1 manually configured, VLAN10
show_output: ipconfig: default gateway blank / not configured
expected_fault: Missing default gateway in static IP configuration

symptom: HSRP failover does not occur when active router's uplink fails
topology_note: R1(active)-R2(standby) HSRP group 1 on VLAN10 SVI
show_output: show standby brief: R1 still Active despite uplink Gi0/1 down; no track object configured
expected_fault: HSRP interface tracking not configured for uplink failure detection

symptom: Guest wireless users get an IP but cannot browse any websites
topology_note: Guest VLAN 99 DHCP pool active, ACL applied for isolation
show_output: show access-lists GUEST-ACL: deny ip any any placed before permit for DNS/HTTP
expected_fault: ACL rule order blocks legitimate traffic before permit statements are reached

symptom: Two access switches show spanning-tree root changing repeatedly
topology_note: SW1, SW2, SW3 in a triangle topology, root bridge not explicitly set
show_output: show spanning-tree: root bridge priority default (32768) on all switches, flapping between SW1/SW2
expected_fault: No primary root bridge configured, causing root election instability

symptom: Remote office loses connectivity to HQ only during business hours
topology_note: R1-R2 link, ACL time-range applied incorrectly
show_output: show access-lists: time-range BUSINESS-HOURS active 8:00-17:00 incorrectly applied to permit statement as deny
expected_fault: Time-based ACL logic inverted, blocking traffic during intended permit window

symptom: New printer on VLAN 10 is unreachable by IP but responds to ping from its own subnet only
topology_note: Printer statically configured, subnet mask entered as /16 instead of /24
expected_fault: Incorrect subnet mask on printer configuration (mismatched with VLAN /24)

symptom: Router-on-a-stick sub-interface for VLAN 50 has correct config but interface remains down
topology_note: R1 Gi0/0.50, physical interface Gi0/0 shut down
show_output: show interfaces gi0/0: administratively down
expected_fault: Physical parent interface administratively shut down, sub-interfaces inherit down state

symptom: NTP time drift causes certificate validation failures on management HTTPS access
topology_note: R1 configured as NTP client to external server
show_output: show ntp status: clock unsynchronized, no valid NTP server reachable
expected_fault: NTP server unreachable, causing clock drift and cert validation failures

symptom: Port-channel between switch and server shows load imbalance with one link idle
topology_note: SW1 to Server1 EtherChannel LACP, 2 links
show_output: show etherchannel load-balance: src-dst-mac hashing algorithm on single-flow traffic
expected_fault: Suboptimal EtherChannel load-balancing hash for traffic pattern

symptom: Branch router fails to register with central SNMP monitoring server
topology_note: R1 SNMP agent configured, community string set
show_output: show run | include snmp-server community: community string does not match monitoring server's configured string
expected_fault: SNMP community string mismatch between agent and monitoring server

symptom: Newly deployed VLAN 60 devices intermittently lose connectivity for a few seconds every few minutes
topology_note: SW1 access ports flapping, port security aging misconfigured
show_output: show port-security interface fa0/15: aging time 1 minute, violation mode restrict, MAC re-learning delay
expected_fault: Port security aging timer too aggressive, causing intermittent MAC re-learning drops

symptom: Redundant WAN link fails to take over when primary ISP circuit goes down
topology_note: R1 dual-WAN with IP SLA tracking configured for failover route
show_output: show ip sla statistics: SLA operation 1 state: Not Started
expected_fault: IP SLA tracking object not started, so failover route never activates
